cases.given: Local edits can drift from the handoff while still passing narrow tests.
cases.expect: Drift is caught before release while routine checkpoints remain cheap.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the task completes in one obvious operation
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Hard constraints and explicit user updates outrank the stored baseline.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Escalate when a hard constraint, core objective, or accepted decision no longer matches current work.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
cases.expect: event-triggered pulse after major state changes in long work

cases.given: At a milestone the build passes, but a newly added assumption contradicts the locked user constraint.
cases.expect: Emit repair-required and escalate despite local test success.
cases.reject: Refresh the baseline so the contradiction disappears.
